about: RW5d P2 shared validator corpus: the problems learnloop.figures.sketch finds; sketchScene.ts must find exactly the same (tests/sketch_scene_corpus.py regenerates it).

scenes.name: not an object
problems: view() must return an object {viewport, elements}

scenes.name: a reversed viewport
problems: viewport.x must be [min, max] with min < max

scenes.name: a viewport with NaN
problems: viewport.x[1] is not a finite number (NaN)

scenes.name: markup at the top level
problems: the scene has unknown keys ["html"]

scenes.name: an image element
problems: element 0: type 'image' is not one of polyline, polygon, points, segment, arrow, circle, rect, text, heat_cells, handle

scenes.name: a missing type
problems: element 0: type 'None' is not one of polyline, polygon, points, segment, arrow, circle, rect, text, heat_cells, handle

scenes.name: a link on text
problems: element 0 (text): unknown keys ["href"]

scenes.name: NaN in a path
problems: element 0 (polyline).x[1] is not a finite number (NaN)

scenes.name: Infinity in a circle
problems: element 0 (circle).cx is not a finite number (Infinity)

scenes.name: a boolean coordinate
problems: element 0 (segment).x1 is not a finite number (True)
element 0 (segment).y2 is not a finite number (NoneType)

scenes.name: lengths differ
problems: element 0 (polyline): x and y have different lengths

scenes.name: text too long
problems: element 0 (text): text must be 1-80 characters

scenes.name: a colour outside the palette
problems: element 0 (points): color must be one of series0, series1, series2, series3, muted, accent

scenes.name: too wide a line
problems: element 0 (points): width must be in (0, 3]

scenes.name: an event in a style
problems: element 0 (points): style may have only color, dash, fill, opacity, width

scenes.name: too many cells
problems: element 0 (heat_cells): cols and rows must be whole numbers with at most 4096 cells

scenes.name: cells and values disagree
problems: element 0 (heat_cells): values must have cols * rows entries

scenes.name: a handle bound to nothing
problems: element 0 (handle): binds.x must name a parameter

scenes.name: a handle with no id
problems: element 0 (handle): id must be letters, digits, - and _ (at most 40), and may not use LearnLoop's check words

scenes.name: an id used twice
problems: element 1 (points): id 'a' is used twice

scenes.name: an id with a check word
problems: element 0 (points): id must be letters, digits, - and _ (at most 40), and may not use LearnLoop's check words

scenes.name: a negative radius and size
problems: element 0 (circle): r must not be negative
element 1 (rect): w and h must not be negative

scenes.name: axes with markup keys
problems: axes may have only x_label and y_label

probe_cases.name: every shape, valid, an extra ignored
not an object
problems: probes() must return an object of the declared probes

probe_cases.name: missing ones
problems: probe 's' is missing
probe 'p' is missing

probe_cases.name: a NaN scalar
problems: probe 's' is not a finite number (NaN)

probe_cases.name: Infinity in a series
problems: probe 'v'[1] is not a finite number (Infinity)

probe_cases.name: a broken pair
problems: probe 'p'[0] is not a pair of finite numbers
